route_tensor: HB router probabilities [8 layers, 10 flow steps, 11 suffix tokens, 32 experts]
score: median_m H(route(V_t, xi_m), route(V_t-1, xi_m)) / median_{V,i<j} H(route(V, xi_i), route(V, xi_j))
threshold_rationale: Dimensionless equality boundary: alarm exactly when changing flow noise moves back-layer action routing more than replacing the previous input version with the current one.

minimal_ablation.status: worse specificity in the mechanism-case controls

interpretation_guard: The alarm measures relative feedback sensitivity of the action routing path. It does not identify semantic belief content or a failed-grasp type.
